subject: Redwood x CloudMarket: SI joint solution workshop scheduling
messages:
From: Pedro Gonzalez <pedro@cloudmarket.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anjali Mehta <anjali@cloudmarket.io>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood x CloudMarket - SI workshop: draft agenda & scheduling

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The CloudMarket SI team (Anjali and I) would like to schedule a joint solution workshop with Redwood to do a technical deep-dive and architecture review ahead of the marketplace integration. Proposed goals:
- Review integration patterns (SaaS connector vs. marketplace-hosted runtime)
- Network & security requirements (VPC peering, KMS, audit logs)
- Deployment & operational runbooks + SLAs
- Workstream ownership and timeline

Suggested slots (PST):
- Wed 2/17, 10:00-11:30
- Thu 2/18, 14:00-15:30
- Mon 2/22, 09:00-10:30

I attached a quick draft agenda (Redwood_CloudMarket_workshop_agenda_v1.pdf). Can you confirm availability and who from your side should join? Also, please loop in your SI lead if different from the product/partnership owners.

Thanks,
Pedro
Pedro Gonzalez
Senior Partnerships Manager
CloudMarket

Attachment: Redwood_CloudMarket_workshop_agenda_v1.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Pedro Gonzalez <pedro@cloudmarket.io>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood x CloudMarket - SI workshop: draft agenda & scheduling

Hi Pedro - great to hear from you and thanks for the agenda.

I've looped in Mateo (partner ops) and Jonas (SI lead) from our side. Quick notes: Jonas will drive the architecture conversation and should be on the call for the full session; Mateo will join for the first 30-45 mins to align on timelines and handoffs.

Of your proposed slots, Thu 2/18 14:00-15:30 PST looks best for us. If that works, we can send a calendar invite and attach a pared-down pre-read for participants.

Two asks before we lock:
1) Can you confirm whether the marketplace integration will require customer-managed keys (KMS) or if platform-managed keys are acceptable for the initial pilot?
2) Any specific compliance artifacts your SI will want ahead of the discussion (SOC 2 evidence, data flow diagrams)?

If Thu 2/18 is firm I'll create an invite and add a short run-of-show.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Anjali Mehta <anjali@cloudmarket.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Pedro Gonzalez <pedro@cloudmarket.io>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 12:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood x CloudMarket - SI workshop: draft agenda & scheduling

Marissa, Pedro - Thu 2/18 14:00-15:30 PST works for our SI engineers. On KMS: for the pilot we prefer platform-managed keys to keep the first integration simple; for production customers we will require customer-managed KMS, so we should cover both flows in the session.

On artifacts: we'll want a high-level data flow and a SOC 2 scoping note; I'll upload our standard questionnaire ahead of time.

Thanks,
Anjali

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Pedro Gonzalez <pedro@cloudmarket.io>, Anjali Mehta <anjali@cloudmarket.io>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood x CloudMarket - SI workshop: draft agenda & scheduling

Thanks - locking Thu 2/18 14:00-15:30 PST. Calendar invite sent (link below) with a short run-of-show and two pre-reads: the agenda you attached and a one-page data-flow diagram.

Run-of-show (30/60/30):
- 14:00-14:30 Introductions & integration patterns (Marissa + Pedro + Jonas)
- 14:30-15:00 Network/security & KMS discussion (Jonas + CloudMarket SI)
- 15:00-15:30 Workstreams, timelines, and next steps (Mateo)

Pre-reads uploaded here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-cloudmarket-pre-read
Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234

Jonas - FYI I added you as co-host and included the meeting deck stub in the invite. Can you review the agenda and add any architecture topics you want covered?

Pedro/Anjali - please confirm the attendee list on your side so we can finalize the invite (we currently have: Anjali, Pedro, one SI engineer).

Best,
Marissa

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2027 16:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood x CloudMarket - SI workshop: draft agenda & scheduling

Looks good - I added two items to the deck:
- KV cache implications for multi-tenant marketplace hosts
- Recommended kernel/quantization profile for marketplace small-instance runtime

Also added a short note on expected logging/trace retention for audit purposes. I'll be prepared to walk through deployment topology and a fallback policy for capacity-constrained customers.

See you all on Thu.

Jonas
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
